headline: Set MarShawn Lloyd as Malik Nabers' AutoSub before Lloyd's 1:25 PM PT kickoff today — no sub is recorded and Nabers is a game-time call for tonight.
summary: Nabers practiced fully all week and the Giants expect him to play, but Sunday reporting still calls it a game-time decision for the 5:20 PM kickoff, so the Lloyd AutoSub is the only safety net if he sits. Everything else on the roster is already locked for week 1, so today's only real task is getting that pairing set before the early window.
